phases.description: Establish project directory, configure Node.js and Express environment, and create initial project files.
Develop the core API functionality for creating, listing, and deleting notes in-memory. Implement ID generation logic.
Integrate comprehensive error handling and validation for note creation inputs.
Implement unit and integration tests for all API endpoints and functionalities.
Prepare the application for deployment, including documentation and basic logging setup.

top_risks.risk: Data loss due to in-memory storage
top_risks.mitigation: Alert users of temporary data nature and consider adding persistence in future updates.
Test extensively under load conditions to refine concurrency handling.
Maintain data size checks and implement memory monitoring tools.

estimate.summary: The overall effort level is moderate due to the straightforward scope of the project. The biggest cost driver is the development and error handling complexity arising from the absence of persistent storage. The key assumption is that the application will not require scalability or persistence enhancements immediately.
